summary: REQ-2 reload persistence needs a browser e2e runner; the repository has none and the sandbox policy forbids downloading browser binaries.

findings.problem: Trusted check manifest lists no e2e/browser command; network policy for the test sandbox is 'deny', so Playwright browsers cannot be installed (repo-map unknowns U-2).
findings.expected_fix: Operator adds a pre-provisioned browser runner to the trusted checks, or allows the pinned browser download for the sandbox.

checked_criteria: Required test levels per requirement determined
Trusted check manifest inspected for an e2e runner
limitations: UI scenarios cannot be executed until a browser runner exists

payload.strategy: Integration tests possible; e2e level unavailable.
